rules.text: this pack is a CLOSED registry of preverbal items that never license invented case/mood/governor effects -- it emits a class label only, never a mood, case or governor key
a particle outside the closed registry (including a genuinely GOVERNING particle like لن or لم) is never swept in; it abstains insufficient_features exactly like an unrecognised surface

bare قد is NOT a member of this registry: its two tense-conditioned readings, and its secondary recency/frequency readings, belong exclusively to inc-qad-tense-conditioned-sense, the sole owner of that authority. This closed registry never resolves a bare-قد occurrence -- in either tense -- and always abstains insufficient_features for it rather than duplicating the owner pack's decision with a weaker gate that would also collapse the owner's preserved rivals

سَوْفَ (vocalized) and سوف (ordinary unpointed) are BOTH registered as exact surface forms of the SAME closed-registry future-marker member -- no lossy normalization collapses one into the other, and a near-miss surface (an extra, missing or altered letter) is never promoted from mere surface similarity
